title: My First ICPC Preliminary — November 2024
excerpt: One problem solved, a first ICPC experience, and a memorable day with my team and the Southeast University programming community.
author: Fazley Rabbi
cover_alt: A group photograph with the Southeast University programming community after the November 2024 ICPC Preliminary.
body:
## A First Step into ICPC

In **November 2024**, I took part in my **first ICPC Preliminary** with my team. It was an exciting opportunity to experience the contest and be part of the competitive programming community at Southeast University.

## One Problem, a Meaningful Milestone

Our team **solved one problem**. As a first-time participant, that result made the day especially memorable. Working alongside my teammates and experiencing the contest together gave me a new perspective on team-based problem solving.

## An Experience to Build On

My first ICPC Preliminary was an amazing experience and an important milestone in my programming journey. It strengthened my motivation to keep practising, improve my problem-solving skills, and return better prepared for future contests.

These photographs capture the contest lab, moments with my team, and the wider Southeast University programming community.
